doc: I30 prereg instrument (BUILD_PLAN I30: 'every law stays under about 1,000 terms', exit 'term-size report within budget'; §1.4 'measure term size before nominal sorts'). Frozen at the I30 prereg; the I30 build reads it and never edits it. Two measures, both mechanical, both recomputed by tests_m3/test_sort_types.py from the files `holon termsize` names. (1) law_terms(L): terms(the `law` blocks of L's emitted LAWS.bend: the law itself, or its counter-law when REFUTED) plus the largest terms(f) over the PROOF.bend files that discharge L (every PROOF.bend under gen/<M>/proofs/<id>/, per-entry files included, and gen/<M>/<id>/nonvac/PROOF.bend when it exists); an UNKNOWN law with no emitted statement counts the statement that would be emitted and no proof. terms(text): drop every line whose first non-blank character is '#' and every import line, cut trailing '# ...' comments; then replace, repeatedly until nothing changes, every bracketed list whose elements are all numeric literals (`[0-9]+n?`) or already-replaced lists by one placeholder (a literal list is one term: a witness's byte strings and words are data, not structure); then count the matches of `tokenizer` plus the placeholders. Budget: law_terms <= `budget` for every I30 law of laws/M3 over an M3 document (prediction I30-P7). (2) cone_chars(L): I12-P1's measure, the sum of len(entry text) over the BendTT kernel cone of L's LAWS.bend in the entries of the one model module it imports as M (holon.bindings.kernel_entries, holon.bindings.kernel_cone; pinned bend), plus len(the LAWS.bend text without comment lines). Ratio budget (prediction I30-P8): cone_chars of the realize law of `ratio_site` on the typed M3 model <= `cone_ratio_max` x cone_chars of the same site's untyped obligation, I15's site form (holon.sorts.sites: the site's minuend >= subtrahend at every hit, `site:` term) stated over the untyped M3 model: the same generator's machine for the same document with the sort section off (no nominal type, no typed operation, no coercion, no generated companion, no ghost store; the same Reach, init, words and loop writes), so that the ratio measures exactly what nominal types and generated tags add. That baseline cannot be frozen here: no M3 model exists at the prereg, and the I20 model (gen/M2/extracted/model.bend) differs from it by Reach, the initial state, the word representation and the loop writes, none of which is a typing cost. `holon termsize` writes the baseline law and model under gen/M3/sorts/untyped/ and the test recomputes both measures from them. Context only (not scored), computed at the prereg by a scratch script implementing (1) and (2) exactly: `context.m2_site_laws` applies (1) to I15's M2 site laws (the literal-list rule changes none of them: they hold no literal list; three exceed 1,000 through their coercion_guard proofs); `context.i20_model` is (2)'s kernel cone of every step_ and chk_ definition of the I20 model, what a Reach over it would reach: 717 of its 799 kernel entries, 6,860,920 characters, against 171,704 for I15's :363 site law on the hand-written model; BendTT's cost is superlinear in this size (docs/BEND_NOTES.md §3), a risk the prompt states.
